title: the script-VM nullable object push adapters, one row per member
heading: ## Per-member rows: the class descriptor each nullable object push adapters pushes (OPUS, 2026-10-03)
lead: The family `script-VM nullable object push adapters` (frontmatter: 295 members; {N} get a row here) shares the forms in the census table above (all reach the push target `00684080`), not repeated per row. What differs from member to member is the class descriptor X its one `lea r8, [X]` hands to the push. Each row anchors that `lea` (the member's distinguishing instruction) and states X and the class X describes. The class is read from the certified image: the static initialiser that does `lea rcx, [X]` and calls a descriptor-constructor wrapper, and that wrapper's `lea r8, [name]` before its one call to `00632D80`; every such initialiser must agree. {CHECK} re-derives every row and compares it with the committed {ROWS}. A member without exactly one `lea r8`, a descriptor not named by exactly one class, or a value that differs fails it. Two controls are refused: a swapped value and a moved anchor. Members that do not derive are listed in [`excluded.tsv`](../../_index/candidates/opus-ee-nullable-push-adapters-1003/excluded.tsv).
